limits: Two storms only: Sep 2024 and Feb 2025. Two points cannot show how the model behaves in other storms.
Sep 2024 is mostly repair backlog: most of its repairs took 20 days or more, so few usable records exist to calibrate on.
Crew counts were never recorded. Crews are a free setting, not an observation, and cannot be checked against data.
Repair time is not outage length. The data records when a damaged asset was fixed, not when customers got power.
Repair days are whole days, so nothing finer than about one day can be claimed.
Circuit level only. There are no outage labels for individual homes, so nothing here measures accuracy for a single address.
note: These results describe two past storms. They are a check on the model, not a guarantee, and not confirmed utility information.

protocol.hit_definition: A circuit is a hit when it had at least 2 damage reports per 1,000 homes in Feb 2025.
protocol.severity: The Feb 2025 forecast uses the feb-2025-like preset: the regional storm size, not any circuit's outcome.

verdicts.sentence: Low-risk areas: 38% of homes were on lines with significant damage, against 54% across all areas (95% range 27% to 51%). This is clearly below the base rate.

High-risk areas: 74% of homes were on lines with significant damage, against 54% across all areas (95% range 51% to 89%). The range reaches the base rate, so the model does not clearly beat the base rate here.
Medium (71%) and High (74%) are not distinguishable: their ranges overlap.

The gap between High and Low areas is 36 percentage points for the risk bands and 27 when circuits are simply ranked by size. The risk bands do not beat the circuit-size baseline by more than the uncertainty.
The High-minus-Low gap is unlikely to be chance (permutation p = 0.009).
Sep 2024 has 30 usable repair records on 2 circuits, too few to fit the number of crews. The run uses a default of 3 crews and is uncalibrated.
82% of repairs finished within the predicted P90 (80% if backlog repairs count as misses). That is close to the 90% a P90 should reach.

The restoration range does not beat any simple baseline (a flat one day, the Sep 2024 median, the Sep 2024 circuit median). The 95% range of each error difference includes zero or favors the baseline.
Repair times are recorded in whole days, so the finest claim is about one day.
